description: The MAKITA HP488D002 18V CORDLESS HAMMER DRIVER DRILL KIT is BUILT FOR SERIOUS PERFORMANCE, CONTROL, AND DURABILITY. Designed within Makita’s trusted G-SERIES platform, this drill delivers RELIABLE POWER and OUTSTANDING VERSATILITY across drilling, driving, and hammering applications. Its ALL-METAL GEAR CONSTRUCTION ensures long-lasting strength, even in demanding high-torque jobs. The MECHANICAL 2-SPEED GEARING lets you easily switch between HIGH-SPEED DRILLING for light-duty work and LOW-SPEED, HIGH-TORQUE mode for tougher materials, giving you TOTAL CONTROL over every task. With 16 CLUTCH SETTINGS and a dedicated DRILL MODE, you can fine-tune torque output for precision fastening. The VARIABLE SPEED TRIGGER offers smooth speed adjustment, while the ELECTRIC BRAKE and CONVENIENT FORWARD/REVERSE SWITCH make operation safe and efficient. A SINGLE-SLEEVE KEYLESS CHUCK allows quick, ONE-HANDED BIT CHANGES, helping you stay productive on the job. Ergonomically designed for comfort and control, the HP488D002 features a RUBBERISED SOFT GRIP that MINIMIZES FATIGUE during long hours of use. At just 1.7 KG, it’s LIGHTWEIGHT, WELL-BALANCED, and EASY TO HANDLE, making it ideal for overhead work or tight spaces. Despite its compact size, it packs serious power—capable of drilling up to 13 MM IN MASONRY/CONCRETE, 36 MM IN WOOD, and 13 MM IN STEEL. Powered by MAKITA’S 18V 1.5AH LITHIUM-ION G-SERIES BATTERIES, this drill offers DEPENDABLE PERFORMANCE with FAST 60-MINUTE CHARGING via the DC18WA CHARGER. Perfect for both professionals and DIY enthusiasts, it’s a VALUE-PACKED KIT that doesn’t compromise on Makita’s legendary quality. The complete KIT INCLUDES 2 x 18V 1.5Ah BATTERIES, 1 x DC18WA CHARGER, a DURABLE CARRY CASE, USER MANUAL, and WARRANTY CARD — giving you everything you need to start drilling, driving, and hammering right out of the box. MAKITA HP488D002 – COMPACT POWER. PROFESSIONAL PRECISION. EVERY TIME.
